source_text: The aim of the reaction is test/optimization:  5-fluoro-4-(2-methyl-1-(tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-yl)-1H-imidazol-5-yl)pyrimidin-2-amine (100 mg, 0.36 mmol), 4-(4-bromo-3-fluorobenzyl)morpholine (109 mg, 0.40 mmol), Palladium, 10% On Charcoal (115 mg, 0.11 mmol), Triphenylphosphine (0.038 mL, 0.16 mmol) and Sodium tert-pentoxide (79 mg, 0.72 mmol) were dissolved in toluene (1.5 mL) and heated to 110 °C under argon.  The reaction was monitorred by HPLC. After 16 h 73 % conversion was achieved. The reaction was stopped and the mixture was discarded.
